shared_elements: quadruped animal shown in profile, in shallow low relief
scale or ranging rod placed against the stone (excavation context)
justification: The most specific correspondence is the profile quadruped carved in very shallow relief with sharply bent, chevron-like legs and a flattened body, which appears as an isolated figure in A and near the top-left of the crowded field in B, both cut into a smoothed slab face. The biggest difference is compositional density and organisation: A leaves a single small creature adrift on a broad blank surface, while B is a tightly packed, register-based programme with a row of arc-topped animals, a hatched band, discs, birds and further quadrupeds, so the two read quite differently as wholes.
